resources.interpretation: Descriptive discrete samples; no leak threshold or resource pass/fail. Top-level status covers ledger/benchmark acceptance only. Missing is not zero. Windows approximately align sample.at to run.started_at; sources and probes are not atomic. Process RSS/PSS, cgroup memory and client memory have different scopes. First/last use timestamped observations; extrema include untimed values. Mixed process identities invalidate counter deltas; extrema may span processes. OOM delta requires two counter observations, consistent PID1 identity, unchanged membership path and no decrease; missing/unsampled intervals and cgroup recreation cannot prove absence of OOM.

controls.scope: Exactly five completed 4000-request allocator controls. The formal hour is excluded and is not asserted complete.
controls.units: MiB = 1048576 bytes; null means unavailable. glibc, pymalloc, THP and RSS scopes overlap and cannot be added.

common_evidence.protocol: 100 queries x 4 modes x 10 repeats = 4000 measured successes per case; 16 separate sequential warmups; max in-flight 4; limit 10; no retries.
common_evidence.source_limits: Same image and query file verified. Probe and driver versions are retained per case; diag-default-01 predates pymalloc stats; plain has no in-process diagnostic wrapper. Source hashes do not replace runtime import-path verification.

timing_definitions.request_blocks_seconds: Sum of measured request-block durations; excludes startup, checkpoint collection and idle.
timing_definitions.ledger_wall_seconds_including_checkpoint: First measured pending to final measured result; includes intervening checkpoints, excludes final checkpoint and idle.
timing_definitions.idle: Configured 120 seconds plus sampling/control latency; actual last-load-snapshot to idle-snapshot interval is reported per case.
timing_definitions.comparison_limit: Equal work, not identical elapsed time. default03 took longer; exact RSS differences and latency differences are not isolated treatment-effect estimates.

supported: Verified per-process THP disable removed observed huge pages and the 120-second idle RSS rise in this full-API workload; restoring default THP reproduced the rise.
Request order, mode/query coverage and response fingerprints match across the sequence; diagnostic wrapper and sampler versions match.
THP is an important causal contributor to continuing RSS growth in these controls. glibc reclaimable retention also exists; pymalloc arena count stays constant within each run.
not_established: The experiments do not attribute all 157.6 MiB of the earlier hour growth or prove absence of leaks.
The owner of the growing THP-eligible anonymous VMA is not identified by smaps alone.
Differences in process age, baseline allocation layout and checkpoint versions limit precise effect sizes; one no-THP run does not establish performance on other workloads.
The production-entrypoint fix still requires its own formal hour acceptance; this summary does not report that run's outcome.
causal_assessment.mapping_evidence: default02 smaps-mid to smaps-late: same 1 GiB VMA 2a030c00000-2a070c00000 retained size, RSS grew 17320 KiB and AnonHugePages 69632 KiB; approximately 97.3% of whole-process RSS growth in that interval. These extra map captures are not exact checkpoint pairs.
